journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: FBBVA Lecture 2023 . The Importance of Modeling Income Taxes over Time: U.S. Reforms and Outcomes
articles.title_cn: FBBVA讲座2023。随时间变化对所得税进行建模的重要性：美国的改革与结果
articles.abstract_en: The structure of taxes and their burden have undergone large and frequent changes over time. We provide a brief history of U.S. federal income tax reform since the 1960s, calculate effective federal income tax rates for each wave of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, and discuss how effective taxation changed from 1969 to 2016. We show that most tax regimes are short-lived and that the variation in taxes over time and across groups is large. We also use an estimated dynamic model of couples and singles to show that the various tax regimes that we estimate imply very different labor market and saving behavior. These findings stress the importance of studying and modeling tax changes over time and across groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 税收结构及其负担随时间发生了大规模且频繁的变化。我们简要回顾了自1960年以来美国联邦所得税改革的历史，为收入动态面板研究的每一波计算有效联邦所得税税率，并讨论了从1969年到2016年有效税收的变化。我们表明，大多数税收制度都是短命的，且税收随时间及群体间的差异很大。我们还使用一个估计的夫妻和单身人士动态模型来表明，我们估计的各种税收制度意味着非常不同的劳动力市场行为和储蓄行为。这些发现强调了研究和建模税收随时间及群体间变化的重要性。

articles.title_en: Presidential Address 2023: The Beauty of Uncertainty: The Rise of Insurance Contracts and Markets in Medieval Europe
articles.title_cn: 主席演讲2023：不确定性的美：中世纪欧洲保险合同与市场的兴起
articles.abstract_en: Maritime insurance developed in medieval Europe is the ancestor of all forms of insurance that appeared subsequently. We address the question of why modern insurance was first invented in medieval Europe, and neither earlier nor elsewhere. Drawing from insights from the literature on uncertainty aversion, we show that medieval merchants had to bear more frequently natural risks (they traveled longer distances) and new human risks with unknown probabilities (they faced unpredictable attacks by corsairs due to increased political fragmentation and commercial competition in Europe). The increased demand for protection in medieval seaborne trade met the supply of protection by a small group of wealthy merchants with a broad information network who could pool risks and profit from selling protection through a novel business device: the insurance contract. A new market—the market for insurance—was then born. Next, analyzing more than 7,000 insurance contracts redacted by notaries and about 100 court proceedings housed in the archives of Barcelona, Florence, Genoa, Palermo, Prato, and Venice, we study the main features of medieval trade, the type of risks faced by merchants, and the characteristics of insurance contracts and markets from 1340 to 1500.The empirical analysis delivers two main findings. First, risks related to human activities (e.g., attacks by corsairs) seem to have had a relatively greater impact on insurance premia compared to natural risks (proxied by seasonal risks). Second, distance mattered but the route seems to have had a greater impact on insurance premia. Specific routes (e.g., in the Tyrrhenian and the western Mediterranean) were more plagued by human risks, which were harder to avoid for the majority of merchants who did not have a broad information network compared to the few wealthy merchants, who became the key players in selling insurance in the early stages of the development of insurance markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 中世纪欧洲发展起来的海上保险是后来出现的所有保险形式的鼻祖。我们探讨了为什么现代保险首先在中世纪欧洲被发明，而不是更早或在其他地方。借鉴不确定性厌恶文献的见解，我们表明中世纪商人不得不更频繁地承受自然风险（他们旅行更长的距离）以及具有未知概率的新的人为风险（由于欧洲政治分裂和商业竞争加剧，他们面临海盗不可预测的袭击）。中世纪海上贸易中对保护需求的增加，与一小群拥有广泛信息网络的富裕商人的保护供给相遇，他们能够分散风险并通过一种新颖的商业工具——保险合同——从出售保护中获利。一个新的市场——保险市场——由此诞生。接下来，通过分析公证人起草的超过7,000份保险合同以及存放在巴塞罗那、佛罗伦萨、热那亚、巴勒莫、普拉托和威尼斯档案中的约100份法庭记录，我们研究了中世纪贸易的主要特征、商人面临的风险类型以及1340至1500年间保险合同和市场的特点。实证分析得出两个主要发现。首先，与人类活动相关的风险（如海盗袭击）似乎对保险费率的影响相对大于自然风险（以季节性风险为代理）。其次，距离很重要，但航线似乎对保险费率的影响更大。特定航线（如第勒尼安海和西地中海）更受人为风险困扰，对于大多数没有广泛信息网络的商人来说，这些风险更难避免，而少数富裕商人则成为保险市场发展早期阶段出售保险的关键参与者。

articles.title_en: Marshall Lecture 2023: Behavioral Macroeconomics via Sparse Dynamic Programming
articles.title_cn: 马歇尔讲座 2023：通过稀疏动态规划的行为宏观经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a tractable way to model boundedly rational dynamic programming. The agent uses an endogenously simplified, or “sparse,” model of the world and the consequences of his actions and acts according to a behavioral Bellman equation. The framework yields a behavioral version of some of the canonical models in macroeconomics and finance. In the life-cycle model, the agent initially does not pay much attention to retirement and undersaves; late in life, he progressively saves more, generating realistic dynamics. In the consumption-savings model, the consumer decides to pay little or no attention to the interest rate and more attention to his income. Ricardian equivalence and the Lucas critique partially fail because the consumer may not pay full attention to taxes and policy changes. In a Merton-style dynamic portfolio choice problem, the agent endogenously pays limited or no attention to the varying equity premium and hedging demand terms. Finally, in the neoclassical growth model, agents act on a simplified model of the macroeconomy; in equilibrium, fluctuations are larger and more persistent.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种对有限理性动态规划进行建模的易处理方法。行为人使用一个内生简化的，或“稀疏”的世界模型及其行为后果，并根据行为贝尔曼方程行动。该框架产生了宏观经济学和金融学中一些经典模型的行为版本。在生命周期模型中，行为人最初对退休关注不足并储蓄不足；在生命后期，他逐渐增加储蓄，产生现实的动态。在消费-储蓄模型中，消费者决定对利率关注很少或不关注，而对收入关注更多。李嘉图等价和卢卡斯批判部分失效，因为消费者可能对税收和政策变化没有充分关注。在默顿式动态投资组合选择问题中，行为人内生地对变化的股权溢价和对冲需求项给予有限或不关注。最后，在新古典增长模型中，行为人基于宏观经济的简化模型行动；在均衡中，波动更大且更持久。

articles.title_en: What do Happiness Data Mean? Theory and Survey Evidence
articles.title_cn: 幸福数据意味着什么？理论与调查证据
articles.abstract_en: What utility notion—e.g. flow/lifetime, self/family-centered—do self-reported well-being (SWB) questions measure? Existing applications make different assumptions regarding the (i) life domains, (ii) time horizons, and (iii) other-regarding preferences captured by SWB data. To obtain relevant evidence, we ask survey respondents what they had in mind regarding (i)–(iii) when answering commonly used—life satisfaction, happiness, ladder—and new SWB questions. We find that respondents’ self-reports differ from researchers’ assumptions and differ across SWB questions and sociodemographic groups. At the same time, simple SWB-question wording tweaks are effective in moving self-reports toward desired interpretations. We outline actionable suggestions for SWB researchers. (JEL: D69, D90, I31)
articles.abstract_cn: 自报幸福感（SWB）问题测量的是哪种效用概念——例如，流动/终身、自我/家庭中心？现有应用对SWB数据所捕捉的（i）生活领域，（ii）时间范围，以及（iii）涉及他人偏好做出了不同假设。为获取相关证据，我们询问调查受访者在回答常用——生活满意度、幸福感、阶梯——及新的SWB问题时，他们对（i）–（iii）的考虑。我们发现受访者的自我报告与研究者的假设不同，且在不同SWB问题和不同社会人口群体间存在差异。同时，简单的SWB问题措辞调整能有效使自我报告趋向预期解释。我们为SWB研究者提出了可操作的建议。（JEL：D69，D90，I31）

articles.title_en: Recruitment Policies, Job-Filling Rates, and Matching Efficiency
articles.title_cn: 招聘政策、职位填补率与匹配效率
articles.abstract_en: Recruitment intensity is important for the matching process in the labor market. Using unique linked survey–administrative data, we investigate the relationships between hiring and recruitment policies at the establishment level. Faster hiring goes along with higher search effort, lower hiring standards, and more generous wages. We develop a directed search model that links these patterns to the employment adjustments of heterogeneous firms. The model provides a novel structural decomposition of the matching function that we use to evaluate the relative importance of these recruitment policies at the aggregate level. The calibrated model shows that hiring standards play an important role in explaining differences in matching efficiency across labor markets defined as region/skill cross-products and for the impact of labor market policy, whereas search effort and wage policies play only a minor role.
articles.abstract_cn: 招聘强度对劳动力市场的匹配过程至关重要。利用独特的链接调查-行政数据，我们研究了企业层面的招聘与雇佣政策之间的关系。更快的雇佣伴随着更高的搜索努力、更低的招聘标准和更慷慨的工资。我们开发了一个定向搜索模型，将这些模式与异质性企业的就业调整联系起来。该模型提供了匹配函数的一种新颖的结构分解，我们利用它来评估这些招聘政策在总体层面的相对重要性。校准模型表明，招聘标准在解释跨劳动力市场（定义为地区/技能交叉产品）的匹配效率差异以及劳动力市场政策的影响方面发挥着重要作用，而搜索努力和工资政策仅发挥次要作用。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the consequences of asset bubbles for economies that are vulnerable to persistent stagnation. Stagnation is the result of a shortage of assets that creates an oversupply of savings and puts downward pressure on the level of interest rates. Once the zero lower bound on the nominal interest rate binds, the real rate cannot adjust further downward, forcing output to fall instead. In such context, bubbles are useful as they expand the supply of assets, absorb excess savings, and raise the natural interest rate—the real rate that is compatible with full employment—crowding in consumption and raising welfare. However, a risky bubble that can collapse with positive probability is smaller and less effective in doing so than a safe bubble. In this case, fiscal policy in the form of promised bailout transfers in case of a bubble collapse, can support an existing bubble and improve its size.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了资产泡沫对易受持续停滞影响的经济体的后果。停滞源于资产短缺，导致储蓄过剩并对利率水平产生下行压力。一旦名义利率触及零下限，实际利率无法进一步下调，迫使产出下降。在此背景下，泡沫是有用的，因为它们扩大了资产供给，吸收了过剩储蓄，并提高了自然利率——即与充分就业相容的实际利率——从而挤入消费并提升福利。然而，一个可能以正概率崩溃的风险泡沫，其规模较小，且在此方面的效果不如安全泡沫。在这种情况下，以泡沫崩溃时承诺救助转移形式出现的财政政策，可以支持现有泡沫并改善其规模。

articles.title_cn: 大流行性衰退与接触者追踪
articles.abstract_en: We study contact tracing in a new macro-epidemiological model with asymptomatic transmission and limited testing capacity. Contact tracing is a testing strategy that aims to reconstruct the infection chain of newly symptomatic agents. This strategy may be unsuccessful because of an externality leading agents to expand their interactions at rates exceeding policymakers’ ability to test all the traced contacts. Complementing contact tracing with timely deployed containment measures (e.g., social distancing or a tighter quarantine policy) corrects this externality and delivers outcomes that are remarkably similar to the benchmark case where tests are unlimited. We provide theoretical underpinnings to the risk of becoming infected in macro-epidemiological models. Our methodology to reconstruct infection chains is not affected by curse-of-dimensionality problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有无症状传播和有限检测能力的新宏观流行病学模型中研究接触者追踪。接触者追踪是一种检测策略，旨在重建新出现症状个体的感染链。由于一种外部性，导致个体以超过政策制定者检测所有被追踪接触者能力的速率扩大其互动，这一策略可能不成功。将接触者追踪与及时部署的遏制措施（如社交距离或更严格的隔离政策）相结合，可以纠正这种外部性，并产生与检测无限制的基准情形非常相似的结果。我们为宏观流行病学模型中感染风险提供了理论基础。我们重建感染链的方法不受维度灾难问题的影响。

articles.title_en: Carbon Taxation and Greenflation: Evidence from Europe and Canada
articles.title_cn: 碳税与绿色通胀：来自欧洲和加拿大的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of carbon pricing on inflation dynamics. We construct a sample of carbon taxes implemented in Europe and Canada over three decades and estimate the response of inflation and price components to carbon pricing. Our empirical results suggest that carbon taxes did not significantly increase inflation, with dynamic effects estimated around zero in most specifications. Instead we find support for relative price changes, increasing the cost of energy but leaving the price of other goods and services unaffected. This is consistent with previous findings on the limited aggregate economic costs of carbon taxes. Based on the cross-section of taxes in Europe, we provide suggestive evidence that the response of inflation was especially muted in countries with revenue-neutral carbon taxes and autonomous central banks that can accommodate potential inflationary pressure associated with carbon pricing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了碳定价对通胀动态的影响。我们构建了欧洲和加拿大三十年间实施的碳税样本，并估计了通胀及其组成部分对碳定价的反应。我们的实证结果表明，碳税并未显著推高通胀，在大多数规格中动态效应估计接近于零。相反，我们发现了相对价格变化的支持证据，即提高了能源成本，但未影响其他商品和服务的价格。这与先前关于碳税有限的总经济成本的发现一致。基于欧洲税收的横截面数据，我们提供了提示性证据，表明在收入中性的碳税和能够适应碳定价可能带来的通胀压力的自主中央银行的国家的通胀反应尤其温和。

articles.title_en: American Indian Casinos and Native American Self-Identification
articles.title_cn: 美国印第安人赌场与美洲原住民自我认同
articles.abstract_en: This paper links Native American racial self-identification with the rise in tribal gaming across the United States. We find that state policy changes allowing tribes to open casinos are associated with an increase in the probability that individuals with American Indian ancestors will self-identify as Native American and a decrease in the probability that individuals with no American Indian ancestry will self-identify as Native American. Moreover, we find that the magnitudes of the impacts are increasing in the strength of American Indian ancestral ties. Similar results hold when causal identification comes from American Indian casino openings across states over time and suggestive evidence shows stronger impacts if casinos are likely to pay per capita dividend payments to their members. These results are consistent with a conceptual framework in which we tie racial identification to economic motivations as well as social stigma associated with affiliating with a racial group for those without documented ancestral ties. Our results underscore the importance of economic incentives and social factors underlying the individual choice of racial identity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了美洲原住民种族自我认同与美国各地部落博彩业兴起之间的联系。我们发现，允许部落开设赌场的州政策变化与有美洲印第安人祖先的个体自我认同为美洲原住民的概率增加，以及无美洲印第安人祖先的个体自我认同为美洲原住民的概率减少相关。此外，我们发现影响程度随美洲印第安人祖先联系的强度而增强。当因果识别来自各州随时间推移的美洲印第安人赌场开设时，结果相似，且暗示性证据表明，如果赌场可能向其成员支付人均股息，则影响更强。这些结果与一个概念框架一致，在该框架中，我们将种族认同与经济动机以及那些没有记录在案的祖先联系的人与某个种族群体相关联的社会污名联系起来。我们的结果强调了经济激励和社会因素在个体种族认同选择中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy, Corporate Finance, and Investment
articles.title_cn: 货币政策、公司金融与投资
articles.abstract_en: In response to a change in interest rates, younger firms not paying dividends adjust both their capital expenditure and borrowing significantly more than older firms paying dividends. The reason is that the debt of younger non-dividend payers is far more sensitive to fluctuations in collateral values, which are significantly affected by monetary policy. The results are robust to a wide range of possible confounding factors. Other channels, including movements in interest payments, product demand, profitability, and mark-ups, are also significant but seem unlikely to explain the heterogeneity in the response of capital expenditure. Our findings suggest that these types of financial frictions play an important role in the transmission of monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为对利率变化的回应，不支付股息的年轻公司在资本支出和借款方面的调整幅度显著大于支付股息的老年公司。原因在于，年轻非股息支付者的债务对抵押品价值波动的敏感度远高于老年公司，而抵押品价值受到货币政策的显著影响。这些结果对一系列可能的混淆因素均保持稳健。其他渠道，包括利息支付变动、产品需求、盈利能力和加成率，也具有显著性，但似乎不太可能解释资本支出反应的异质性。我们的研究结果表明，这类金融摩擦在货币政策的传导中发挥着重要作用。

articles.abstract_en: We consider the problem of a leader who can assign rewards for citizens for different anti-regime actions. Citizens face a coordination problem in which each citizen has a private, endogenous degree of optimism about the likelihood of regime change. Because more optimistic citizens are easier to motivate, the choice of optimal rewards entails optimal screening. This leads to a distribution of anti-regime actions. A key result is the emergence of a vanguard, consisting of citizens who engage in the endogenous, maximum level of action. Other citizens participate at varying degrees, with less optimistic citizens contributing less. We explore how the regime’s strength or the maximum reward available to the leader influences the distribution of actions. Moreover, we show that more heterogeneity (e.g., higher inequality) among potential revolutionaries reduces the likelihood of regime change. Our methodological contribution is that we deliver a sharp and novel marriage of screening and global games.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个领导者可以为公民的不同反政权行动分配奖励的问题。公民面临一个协调问题，其中每个公民对政权更迭可能性拥有私人的、内生的乐观程度。由于更乐观的公民更容易被激励，最优奖励的选择涉及最优筛选。这导致了反政权行动的分布。一个关键结果是先锋队的出现，由参与内生最大行动水平的公民组成。其他公民以不同程度的参与，较不乐观的公民贡献较少。我们探讨了政权的力量或领导者可获得的最大奖励如何影响行动的分布。此外，我们表明，潜在革命者之间更大的异质性（例如，更高的不平等）降低了政权更迭的可能性。我们的方法论贡献在于，我们提供了筛选和全局博弈的清晰而新颖的结合。

articles.abstract_en: This study proposes a real-time estimate of inattention, based on micro-level data. I show that a simple specification that estimates the persistence of a forecaster's deviation from the mean provides a direct estimate of parameters of information frictions according to prominent models of expectations. The new estimate can also be interpreted as a hybrid measure of both information frictions and behavioral frictions. Using the new specification, I revise several key findings documented in the previous literature. I find higher levels of inattention and document new forms of variations over time and across variables, horizons, individuals, and types of agents. I also report new results from long-run forecasts and document an unprecedented response to COVID-19.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究基于微观层面数据提出了一种对注意力不足的实时估计。我表明，一个简单的规范，即估计预测者偏离均值的持续性，可以直接估计根据著名预期模型的信息摩擦参数。新的估计也可以解释为信息摩擦和行为摩擦的混合度量。使用新的规范，我修正了先前文献中记录的几项关键发现。我发现了更高水平的注意力不足，并记录了随时间、变量、预测期限、个体和代理人类型的新变化形式。我还报告了长期预测的新结果，并记录了对COVID-19前所未有的反应。
